words: Why am I only getting to this now? Get the total down as far as it'll go. Altogether I've 30500 US cents to spend - that's the whole lot, so not a cent more than that will be coming out of the purse. Two kids, one telly in the sitting room – and our old streamer has gone to seed, so I'm planting a replacement before the weekend film night. Every item on the list should be there ready and waiting for me - none of them missing from the shelf. Here's my list - 1 x computer monitor with a contrast ratio of 1300:1; 1 x streaming media player with a resolution of 6k and a processor that is not h616; and 1 x home soundbar, speaker or subwoofer with a sensitivity of at least 93 db and a plug type of 3 pin or universal. I'll only receive 3 messages from you - anything after that is turned away. The home soundbars, speakers & subwoofers needs to be one that suits the chosen computer monitors. We've 99 steps - then we're finished - done or not. The streaming media players needs to be one that suits the chosen computer monitors.
